sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the requirement’s applicability, frame-specific alternatives, two-side threshold, bracket thickness comparison, edge-stiffening evidence, datatypes, and millimetre units; no repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the longitudinal-frame rule so that every supporting web frame and bulkhead is individually associated with a bracket; the current existence of one nltl:hasConnectionBracket lets frames with multiple unbracketed supports pass. Locate a canonical support-to-bracket/attachment association term. Apply the ice-strengthened-area condition consistently to the longitudinal, transverse, pass-through, thickness, and edge-stiffening rules, including bracket constraints via the owning frame. For terminating transverse frames, encode the permitted alternative as a connection bracket OR a similar frame attachment; requiring only nltl:hasFrameAttachment can reject a bracket-only case.

Candidate faithfully encodes the requirement’s applicability, frame-specific alternatives, two-side threshold, bracket thickness comparison, edge-stiffening evidence, datatypes, and millimetre units; no repair is required.
